_comment: Copy to agent-config.json and run: python -m contauth.agent --config agent-config.json

_notes.enroll_windows: More windows = a steadier profile and fewer false locks (20 ~= 1.7 min of use).
_notes.high_consecutive: HIGH windows in a row before locking. 3 is gentler than the default 2.
_notes.warmup_minutes: After launch, behaviour step-ups only warn for this long; bots/cookie-replay still lock.
_notes.lock_cooldown_seconds: After a lock, do not lock again for this long (so signing back in is not interrupted).
_notes.monitor_only: true = never lock, only log. Good for your first days with the agent.
_notes.dry_run: true = log 'would lock' instead of actually locking (safe for testing).
